contract.arithmetic: exact Q(phi); coefficient and finite localization errors zero on the declared finite model
contract.auxiliary_dynamics: action state advances only at evolve events; no physical duration assigned
contract.clock: one supplied tau per completed action step; auxiliary events counted separately
contract.observer_partition: 64 field patches; pointers at detector sites32..63; public collector owns inbox/acc/D; controller owns clock
contract.routing: supplied authenticated classical record channels to one detector accumulator
contract.units: dimensionless parent action time c*t/L and parent field normalization
